minutes.headline: Finance Committee tabled all votes and will invite town counsel to discuss his capital plan amendment opinion.
minutes.summary: The chair read his request and town counsel's written opinion on how far the Finance Committee and Town Meeting may amend the capital plan, and members disagreed about it. A public hearing on deferred FY23 warrant articles covered primary school air conditioning, the new facilities director position and the bylaw changes. Votes on article recommendations, the consent calendar and minutes were put off to April 28. The committee voted to close the public hearing.

public_comment.topic: Said town counsel's letter is confusing and objected that a voter cannot change a capital plan item at Town Meeting.
Questions on the facilities director role and Parks involvement, the primary school air conditioning cost and process, and the all-or-nothing capital plan.
Noted the sale of a property on Weston and Lemons Road for thirty five thousand dollars and asked for an analysis of when an override may be needed.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted unanimously to close the public hearing on the FY23 budget, capital plan and warrant articles.
Votes on article recommendations were tabled until the next meeting, and approval of two sets of minutes was deferred.
The chair will invite town counsel to the April 28 meeting to discuss an opinion on how far the capital plan can be amended; members disagreed about it.
Members discussed whether stabilization articles 9 and 10 belong on the consent calendar and will correspond with the moderator.
The hearing covered primary school air conditioning, which sits in the capital plan with sufficiency unknown pending a peer review.

why_it_matters: Whether Town Meeting voters can change a single capital plan item, such as primary school air conditioning, or must take the plan whole is unresolved, and it shapes what voters can do at Town Meeting.
The committee's recommendations on the warrant articles, including the stabilization funding articles, were not made on this night, so residents have no committee position yet.
watch_next: April 28 Finance Committee meeting: town counsel invited on the capital plan opinion, and the tabled article recommendation votes.
The moderator's answer on whether stabilization articles 9 and 10 stay on the consent calendar.
